milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward the red sand patch and look at it. The red sand center is at approximately (5, -1, 4) spawn-relative. Max distance set to 5 to ensure the player actually walks toward it (since it's only ~6 blocks from spawn, a distance of 5 means they need to move closer). Facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures they are looking at the red sand area.

Uses inventory_has because mining red concrete powder drops the block itself as an item into the player's inventory. Red concrete powder always drops itself regardless of tool used. The player has a wooden shovel which speeds up mining. Checking for at least 1 confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has because mining a clay block drops 4 clay_ball items into the player's inventory. The drop is clay_ball (not the clay block itself) unless Silk Touch is used, which the player does not have. Checking for at least 1 clay_ball confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted brown bed ends up in the player's inventory. This is a two-step craft: first dye white wool with brown dye to get brown wool (3x), then combine 3 brown wool + 3 oak planks at the crafting table to produce a brown bed. All materials are provided in starting inventory and a crafting table is available at (~1, 0, ~2).
